scope: Phase 059 Step 34.4 independent physics/numerics probes over the v1.0.14-v1.0.18.2 production-code lineage
method: Read-only imports of frozen release modules; independent analytic identities, finite differences, asymptotes, limit tests, permutation tests, and material-scope checks; no release test/demo invocation.
authority_boundary: Execution PASS means the probes completed and their evidence is internally validated. BLOCKER_CONFIRMED is not a scientific PASS and the probes do not establish experimental validity.

probes.title: pointwise recurrence normalization and linear-source exactness
probes.contract: A normalized exponential memory preserves a constant source and exactly integrates a linear source on each segment.
probes.acceptance: both maximum errors < 1e-12
probes.interpretation: The v1.0.15 pointwise recurrence itself satisfies its local normalization/exact-integration contract.

probes.title: wide-window capacity conservation with peak suppression/broadening
probes.contract: For a resolved causal lag on a sufficiently wide voltage window, integral(dQ/dV)dV approaches Q while peak height falls and FWHM grows.
probes.acceptance: area error < 1e-8; lagged peak lower; lagged FWHM larger
probes.interpretation: The direct-LV mathematical kernel can produce the user's qualitative suppression/broadening observation without losing transition capacity on a wide window.

probes.title: resolved small-LV continuity toward equilibrium
probes.contract: At fixed adequate resolution, the causal peak converges continuously to the equilibrium derivative as L_V decreases.
probes.acceptance: max-error sequence strictly decreases and all areas remain within 1e-8 of Q
probes.interpretation: The resolved branch has the correct L_V->0 trend; this does not validate the provenance of L_V.

probes.title: charge/discharge mirror identity
probes.contract: With zero polarization/hysteresis and symmetric parameters, reversing both direction and voltage about U must mirror the same positive peak.
probes.acceptance: mirror max error < 1e-12 and both progress-coordinate areas approach Q
probes.interpretation: The fixed-direction mirror convention is internally coherent.

probes.title: input chronology is erased by voltage sorting
probes.contract: A history-dependent model must distinguish different acquisition orders of the same voltage coordinates unless the API explicitly declares an unordered curve.
probes.acceptance: defect is confirmed when restored model output is invariant while an order-following recurrence differs materially
probes.interpretation: dqdv sorts voltage before evolving memory. It therefore cannot represent pulses, reversals, loops, pauses, or measurement chronology from the supplied order.

probes.title: derived kinetic path has an equilibrium zero-current branch
probes.contract: A rate-derived lag must vanish at I=0 and the observable must equal equilibrium.
probes.acceptance: I=0 difference = 0 and resolved lag length = 0
probes.interpretation: The derived path implements the formal zero-current branch, although its units and barrier closure remain separate issues.

probes.title: direct LV override bypasses the zero-current limit
probes.contract: Any physical finite-current lag must disappear when I approaches zero; a fit convenience parameter cannot silently override that limit.
probes.acceptance: defect is confirmed when I0 equals I1 but differs from equilibrium
probes.interpretation: The override is useful as a diagnostic kernel but is not a valid physical current law in its present unconditional precedence.

probes.title: C-rate per hour is passed to a per-second attempt-frequency law
probes.contract: For Q_cell=3600 C, 1C means 1 A; c_rate[1/h] must be divided by 3600 before entering I/Q in an SI-second kinetic law.
probes.acceptance: defect is confirmed when kinetic ratio is 3600 and code-implied current is 3600 A
probes.interpretation: The curve facade and func_L_q use incompatible hour/second contracts unless Q_cell is redefined away from the documented charge unit.

probes.title: constant-n thermal width derivative
probes.contract: For w=nRT/F with constant n, dw/dT=nR/F.
probes.acceptance: finite-difference/code error < 1e-12
probes.interpretation: The explicit constant-n branch propagates the thermal width derivative correctly.

probes.title: n(T) width derivative and fixed-state entropy chain
probes.contract: For n(T)=n0+n1(T-Tref), dw/dT=(R/F)(n(T)+T n1), and dU(x)/dT=dS/F+(dw/dT)logit(x).
probes.acceptance: both finite-difference errors < 1e-10
probes.interpretation: The v1.0.16 n(T) algebra and its configurational entropy propagation are internally consistent for one transition.

probes.title: w-only empirical width remains temperature-frozen
probes.contract: A direct empirical w without n is constant in temperature and has dw/dT=0.
probes.acceptance: both derivative magnitudes < 1e-12 and widths equal
probes.interpretation: The w-only branch is a clearly empirical, temperature-frozen width law.

probes.title: implicit default width and entropy derivative disagree
probes.contract: If missing n/w defaults to n=1 and w=RT/F, the same branch must use dw/dT=R/F rather than zero.
probes.acceptance: defect is confirmed when finite difference equals R/F but code returns zero
probes.interpretation: The observable and entropy paths assign different temperature laws to the same implicit default transition.

probes.title: n(T) positivity guard
probes.contract: Any parameterized transition width must remain strictly positive over the evaluated temperature range.

measurements.exception: ValueError: width w=n(T)·RT/F must be > 0 (n(T)≤0 at some T — check n/n_T1/n_T_ref).

probes.acceptance: a ValueError is raised for n(T)<=0
probes.interpretation: The v1.0.16 fail-fast guard prevents negative or zero peak widths at evaluated points.

probes.title: n shadows w when both are supplied
probes.contract: Two exposed fit parameters must not be presented as simultaneously identifiable when one has exact precedence and the other is inert.
probes.acceptance: caution is confirmed when changing w produces exactly zero curve change
probes.interpretation: The n/w API is a mutually exclusive parameterization, not two independently estimable width controls.

probes.title: Einstein voltage-shift derivative equals entropy difference over F
probes.contract: The reference-subtracted free-energy voltage shift must satisfy d(Delta U_vib)/dT=Delta S_vib/F.
probes.acceptance: maximum derivative error < 1e-10 and both reference-subtracted quantities equal zero
probes.interpretation: The additive v1.0.18.2 Einstein free-energy/entropy pair is thermodynamically self-consistent.

probes.title: Einstein F, S, internal-energy identity and asymptotes
probes.contract: For one thermal Einstein oscillator without zero-point energy, U=F+TS, S->0 at low T, and S~R[1+ln(T/theta)] at high T.
probes.acceptance: all values finite; identity error < 1e-8 J/mol; low entropy < 1e-10; high-T relative error < 1e-6
probes.interpretation: The stated single-oscillator thermodynamic identities are numerically satisfied over a wide positive-temperature range.

probes.title: nonpositive Einstein reference temperature is not rejected
probes.contract: The Einstein reference temperature must be finite and strictly positive before any theta/T or thermal free-energy evaluation.
probes.acceptance: defect is confirmed when no ValueError is raised before non-finite arithmetic
probes.interpretation: theta_E is guarded positive, but theta_E_Tref uses only a finite-value guard.

probes.title: Einstein capability is dormant in all shipped defaults
probes.contract: An additive capability with no populated material parameter does not validate any released graphite or LCO prediction.
probes.acceptance: scope absence is confirmed when key counts are zero
probes.interpretation: v1.0.18.2 adds a mathematically consistent option but no material-specific vibrational calibration or validation.

probes.title: LCO electronic entropy is frozen at 298.15 K
probes.contract: If the theory claims Sommerfeld electronic entropy proportional to temperature, the effective entropy and integrated center shift cannot be temperature-constant.
probes.acceptance: defect is confirmed when all effective entropy values are exactly equal
probes.interpretation: The seam is internally shared, but it implements a single-reference constant offset rather than the document's T-dependent electronic law.

probes.title: default LCO has no rate-dependent kinetic broadening
probes.contract: A model intended to explain current-induced LCO peak suppression/broadening must have an active rate path beyond optional ohmic translation.
probes.acceptance: defect is confirmed when I=0 and I=1 curves are identical at Rn=0
probes.interpretation: The released LCO defaults cannot test the founding current-broadening hypothesis.

probes.title: doped high-voltage LCO state is absent from defaults
probes.contract: Explaining doped high-voltage LCO requires explicit composition/surface/oxygen-loss state and data-supported transitions above the present placeholder range.
probes.acceptance: scope absence is confirmed when maximum U is 4.05 V and no dopant/degradation key is present
probes.interpretation: The shipped three-transition LCO set is a tier-C demonstration placeholder, not a high-voltage doped-LCO fit model.

probes.title: lag/barrier closure is independent of local voltage or affinity
probes.contract: A transition barrier hypothesized to depend on electrode potential and local thermodynamic driving force must receive/evaluate a local state variable rather than one frozen cutoff value per transition.
probes.acceptance: defect is confirmed when the signature has no local voltage/affinity and changing U leaves lag unchanged
probes.interpretation: The current closure cannot express the user's central hypothesis that temperature, current, and electrode potential jointly modify the activation barrier.
